title: Zepto Product Scraper
description: Scrape product search results from Zepto by query and export structured product data.

startUrl.title: Search URL
startUrl.description: Optional Zepto search URL. Its query parameter is used when Search query is empty.

query.title: Search query
query.description: Search keyword to scrape from Zepto. Takes precedence over Search URL when supplied.

results_wanted.title: Maximum number of products
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of products to save.

max_pages.title: Maximum pages
max_pages.description: Safety cap for search pages to fetch.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Use Apify Proxy for better reliability.
